title: the_ninth_block
beats: Every parkour map I speedrun has the same phantom block on block 9 — one nobody else can see.
I'm 22, I've been posting parkour clips for two years, and this map is my personal record: 4.7 seconds.
Last week my viewer, a regular named grieferkid_04, commented: 'why do you jump over nothing on block 9?'
I ignored it. Ran it again. Jumped over nothing again, out of habit.
Then I zoomed into my own old clips from a year ago — before grieferkid_04 ever started watching.
In every single one, I jump the same spot. Before he ever mentioned it.
I checked the map's file history tonight. Block 9 was removed by the creator eleven months ago for 'being glitched.'
I never downloaded the update. My world still loads the old version — the block that isn't supposed to exist anymore.
So what exactly am I still jumping over?
